description: S9 unit U8 (M7 adapters/monitoring_web.py, the loopback read-only viewer; OWNER-DECISIONS-S9 D2.1), characterized before the move into observation.adapters.viewer_http: a real ThreadingHTTPServer built by handler(snapshot_path) on 127.0.0.1 with an ephemeral port, served from a thread and driven with http.client (mirrors tests/test_monitoring.py test_http_rejects_mutations_hosts_and_unavailable_snapshot, test_web_json_route_preserves_the_backlog_envelope, test_index_falls_back_to_legacy_without_build_and_assets_are_strict and tests/test_monitor_readiness.py test_liveness_and_snapshot_api_keep_their_own_contracts, test_host_guard_and_read_only_refusal_cover_the_new_route, test_stale_snapshot_recovers_on_the_same_server_without_restart): /, /legacy and /assets/<name> (the packaged assets, traversal, bad pattern, bad suffix, missing, the 128-character bound, the 5,000,000-byte asset bound over a substituted resource directory, the legacy-page fallback); /api/status (valid, missing, at and over the 5,000,000-byte bound, non-JSON, truncated, empty, binary, directory -> 503), /health, /ready (fresh, stale, future, missing, undecodable; the viewer's readiness clock fixed by wrapping the module attribute with an explicit now); unknown -> 404; a wrong, absent or portless Host -> 403 before routing; POST -> 405 before the Host check; every response's headers including the CSP; serve(desk=<object>) on the viewer port -> ValueError before any bind, and the desk-free bind is 127.0.0.1 on the given port (a recording server class). Desk-enabled routes are S10's entry.http.desk family. Declared driver-side normalization, no mask-list entry: the ephemeral port is only the symbol <port> in a request's Host header, the Date and Server response headers are dropped and counted, and the temp directory never appears in a result
